cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(NativeExtractionOrder C)
add_library(first STATIC first.c)
add_library(second STATIC second.c)
target_compile_options(first PRIVATE -O2)
target_compile_options(second PRIVATE -O2)
add_executable(hello main.c)
target_compile_options(hello PRIVATE -O0)
if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  target_link_libraries(hello PRIVATE first second)
else()
  target_link_libraries(hello PRIVATE second first)
endif()
add_custom_command(TARGET hello POST_BUILD COMMAND "$<TARGET_FILE:hello>")
